# <span id="aanchor420"></span> Ticket Search

Users can search for tickets using the Ticket Search screen. Companies can accumulate thousands of tickets, making it difficult to find specific tickets. The Ticket Search screen is configured to select either one, or many filters to narrow down a search. This screen also allows for multiple searches from within the same screen.

Ticket Search lets users find tickets based on one or more of the following criteria: product, ticket type, time frame and location the ticket is attached to. Users can create multiple searches by adding additional tabs to the UI.

<div class="procedure">

To open Ticket Search:

Go to **Open** \> **Tickets** \> **Ticket Search**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" />

</div>

Any edits made to the Batch Detail opened from the Ticket Search screen only performs an edit to that batch and its selected underlying periodics. Because of this, the effective dates for Flow Data, Characteristics and Analysis are read-only in this view. Additionally, since FLOWCAL is only aware of the data in the batch being edited, when a PPA is performed the percent change values displayed at save time are for the batch only.

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Ticket Search Screen Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following items are available on the Ticket Search screen:

- **Master search tab** - By creating new tabs using the button, the conditions and results of multiple searches can be simultaneously maintained, allowing the user to find tickets that meet various criteria without having to continually change the query and lose the prior search.

- **Current search conditions** - This section displays the selected search criteria.

  Users can remove search criteria by right-clicking a search condition and selecting **Remove Filter**.

- **Search criteria** - Here, the user can use the drop-down to specify a data point to filter by. The user may then enter the actual criteria to filter the search below. To add new search criteria all the user needs to do is change the option in the drop-down menu, FLOWCAL will automatically add the selection to the current search conditions box.

  When searching by ticket type, the following ticket types will only be available when licensed for the Liquids Inventory module: Cavern Level, Tank Gauge, Tank Run, and Inventory Empty.

- **Refresh** - This will cause the current search conditions to be run, refreshing the grid with the most up to date data for all tickets that meet the search criteria.

- **Data navigation type** - These tabs separate ticket data into distinct sections that allow for easier viewing of related information.

- **Ticket search grid** - This is where all tickets and batches that meet the conditions specified by the user’s search are displayed. The user may open the Ticket Editor Detail for a given ticket by double-clicking on it in the grid. The Batch Details screen can be opened to view batch data by double-clicking on a batch. A right-click option on batches called Open Volume Editor is also available to allow the user to open the Volume Editor for the meter and month of the Batch Ticket selected.

  FLOWCAL will only display up to 10,000 tickets. If the search criteria will compile more than 10,000 tickets, the message "(Truncated)" will display in the status bar at the bottom of the screen, followed by the number of tickets displayed on that tab.

- **Right-click menu options** - The functions available in the right-click options menu are **New Ticket** and **New from Profile**. These options function the same as their counterpart options found in the right-click menu in the Ticket Editor. [Ticket Editor](Ticket%20Editor.md).

  Right-clicking anywhere on the grid and selecting **New Ticket** will open a blank ticket editor detail from which a new ticket may be created. Unlike creating a ticket through the Ticket Editor, the ticket type must be specified when creating a new ticket, and tickets of all types (other than Inventory Empty) may be created here. As with the Ticket Editor, batch data can be viewed from the Ticket Search form.

  When a user hovers over the **New From Profile** option, a sub-menu displays a list of available Ticket Types from where you can then choose the Profile Name from all Autofill Profiles for the corresponding Ticket Type. Once an Autofill Profile is selected, a new ticket is automatically populated with the default values for that profile. (See: [Ticket Autofill Editor](Ticket%20Autofill%20Editor.md))

</div>
